title: Kelsey's and Anoosha's Art-Book Videos
content: Kelsey Rodriguez's YouTube channel has made her a hero for self-taught artists, so I was pleased that she included my bookColor and Lightamong her recommendations in her videoon YouTubeKelsey Rodriguez:ART BOOKS to read instead of going to art school!Also, Anoosha Syed did arecommended art book videowhich includes a review ofColor and Light.Thanks, Kelsey and Anoosha!
